claims.text: Using ChatGPT enhances the frequency and flexibility of creative output in creative writing tasks.
Using ChatGPT reduces inaccuracy and unclarity in written creative outputs.
Using ChatGPT reduces the time required to complete creative writing tasks.
Using ChatGPT reduces the perceived effort and intellectual demand of creative writing tasks.
Using ChatGPT reduces the perceived enjoyment and value of creative writing tasks.
Non-native English speakers obtain greater performance benefits in creative writing tasks from ChatGPT compared to native speakers.
Non-native English speakers experience greater changes in task perception regarding effort and enjoyment when using ChatGPT.
Participants report low moral acceptability and trust regarding unregulated AI in creative writing tasks.
Transparency in AI usage mitigates ethical concerns among participants in creative writing tasks.

evidence.description: Participants who used ChatGPT were more likely to perform better, showing higher frequency and flexibility of creativity in writing.
ChatGPT-assisted participants showed less inaccuracy and unclarity in their writing output.
ChatGPT-assisted participants required less time to complete the creative writing task.
Participants using ChatGPT found the creative writing task to be less effortful and intellectually demanding in post-task surveys.
Participants using ChatGPT reported that the creative writing task was less enjoyable and valued.
Non-native English speakers benefited most from ChatGPT in task performance in the experimental writing study.
Non-native English speakers were most affected by perception changes regarding task enjoyment and effort.
Participants reported low moral acceptability and trust in unregulated AI in pre- and post-task surveys.
Survey responses indicated that transparency mitigates some ethical concerns regarding AI integration.

methodologies.name: Controlled user experiment with pre- and post-task surveys
methodologies.description: Evaluated task performance and perceptions of 225 university students completing a creative writing task with or without ChatGPT assistance.
